mpPrToTable.Description: Filling the specification table with selected ModPlus products
mpPrToTable.FullDescription: Collecting data for the specification from extended product data (blocks created by the "Insert product" plugin, or AutoCAD primitives with the expanded data added by the "Insert product" plugin), as well as from blocks that have attributes for the specification. It is possible to specify a line from which the table will be populated
mpPrToTable.h1: Select entities that are ModPlus products
mpPrToTable.h4: Ask a row to start filling
mpPrToTable.h5: A number of symbols after comma
mpPrToTable.h7: Wrong choice! This is not a table!
